definition_en: water strongly saturated with salt; sea water; also to soak in brine
core_image: 木桶里泡着青绿色的黄瓜，浓盐水面浮着几粒胡椒
scene: 祖母的储藏室里一排陶缸。Grandmother kept her pickles in a crock of dark brine all winter.
sceneCN: 这里 brine 是「盐水、卤水」（第 1 个义项：高浓度盐溶液）；句意是祖母整个冬天把腌菜泡在一缸深色卤水里。

collocations.phrase: the salty brine of the sea

derivatives.zh: 由名词加形容词后缀构成，义为「咸的；多盐的」
由形容词加名词后缀构成，义为「咸味；盐度」

senses.title: Strongly salted water
senses.definition: water with a high concentration of dissolved salt
senses.example: The olives cured for weeks in brine.
senses.exampleCN: 橄榄在卤水里腌了数周。
senses.why: The Germanic root meant salt itself, so the word first named the dissolved form of salt.
senses.whyCN: 日耳曼词根本义为盐，此词最初即指盐的溶解形态。

senses.title: Sea water
senses.definition: the salty water of the sea, in literary use
senses.definitionCN: 海之咸水，用于文学语体
senses.example: Sailors washed the deck with cold brine.
senses.exampleCN: 水手用冰冷的海水冲洗甲板。
senses.why: The sea is nature's own barrel of brine, so the word widens to the ocean.
senses.whyCN: 大海是天然的大盐桶，词义便扩展至海洋。

senses.title: To preserve in salt water
senses.definition: to soak food in brine to preserve or season it
senses.definitionCN: 把食物浸泡在盐水中以便保存或入味
senses.exampleCN: 她把火鸡在盐水中泡了一夜。
senses.why: The noun names the bath; the verb borrows the name for the act of bathing in it.
senses.whyCN: 名词命名那缸浴液，动词借其名指浸泡这一动作。

senses.title: Natural salt deposits and springs
senses.definition: underground or spring water rich in salt, exploited for salt-making
senses.definitionCN: 富含盐分的地下水或泉水，用于制盐
senses.example: The town grew rich boiling brine from its wells.
senses.exampleCN: 这座小镇靠熬煮井中盐卤致富。
senses.why: Before sea salt, wells of brine were the oldest salt factories.
senses.whyCN: 在海盐之前，盐卤井是最古老的盐厂。

senses.title: Tears, figuratively
senses.example: Her face was washed with brine.
senses.why: Tears are the body's own salt water, the smallest sea we carry.
senses.whyCN: 泪水是身体自带的盐水，是我们随身携带的最小海洋。

senses.title: A habitat of salt-loving life
senses.definition: very salty water where specialized organisms live, as brine pools
senses.definitionCN: 特化生物栖居的超盐水域，如盐池
senses.example: Brine pools on the seabed host strange shrimp.
senses.exampleCN: 海底盐池里栖居着奇虾。
senses.why: Concentration has degrees, and the word grades up to the extreme end.
senses.whyCN: 浓度有等级，词义随之升到极端一端。

senses.title: Industrial salt solutions
senses.definition: salt solution used in industry, as in refrigeration or chemistry
senses.definitionCN: 用于制冷、化工等行业的盐溶液
senses.example: The plant circulates brine through its cooling pipes.
senses.exampleCN: 工厂让盐水在冷却管中循环。
senses.why: Salt water freezes below zero, so brine becomes a machine's blood.
senses.whyCN: 盐水冰点在零下，盐卤便成了机器的血液。

senses.title: The taste of the sea on things
senses.definition: the brackish, salty flavor the sea leaves on skin or food
senses.definitionCN: 海留在皮肤或食物上的咸涩味
senses.example: Wind and brine had stiffened the old fisherman's hair.
senses.exampleCN: 风与盐卤把老渔夫的头发吹得又硬又挺。
senses.why: The sea seasons everything it touches, and the word names the seasoning.
senses.whyCN: 海把它触碰的一切都腌上一遍，这个词命名的正是那一层腌味。

intro.en: Brine is an Old English word, bryne or brine, related to words for salt burning, with Germanic cousins throughout.
intro.cn: brine 是古英语词（bryne 或 brine），与表「盐之灼烈」的词相关，日耳曼语亲属遍布。

items.en: A reconstructed root *brīnan- has been proposed for burn or salt-hot; the connection remains debated.
items.cn: 有学者提出重构词根 *brīnan-（灼烧或盐之灼烈），但与盐的关联仍有争议。

items.en: Old English brine meant the sea, or salt water, in poetry and prose.
items.cn: 古英语 brine 指海或咸水，诗文并用。

items.en: Old Saxon brina and Old Frisian brine show the same word across the North Sea.
items.cn: 古撒克逊语 brina 与古弗里西亚语 brine 显示该词横跨北海。

items.en: Middle English settled brine for strong salt water and the sea alike.
items.cn: 中古英语中 brine 定型为浓盐水与海水的通称。

items.en: The verb brined appears in cookery and trade texts.
items.cn: 十六世纪起动词 brined 见于烹饪与商贸文本。

items.en: Modern use spans kitchens, chemists, and poets of the sea.
items.cn: 现代用法横跨厨房、化学与咏海的诗人。

note.en: Brine's sound twins are unrelated words; its near group is the vocabulary of salt and sea.
note.cn: brine 的同音词与它无关；近义组是盐与海的词汇。

entries.definition: its verb use, as in brined fish
entries.definitionCN: 其动词用法：brined fish（盐渍鱼）

entries.definition: tiny creatures living in salt lakes
entries.definitionCN: 卤虫；栖于盐湖的小生物

entries.definition: a well or pit of salt water
variant spelling of briny, now rare
entries.definitionCN: briny 的异体拼写，今罕见
含盐的；医学中指生理盐水

entries.definition: a brine or vinegar solution for preserving
entries.definitionCN: 腌渍液；侧重成品与风味

entries.definition: a seasoned soaking liquid, usually not salty
entries.definitionCN: 腌汁；以香料为主，盐度较低

entries.definition: the salt water of the ocean

normalIntro.en: One syllable holds the sea: brine is the sea in a barrel.
normalIntro.cn: 一个音节装着大海：brine 就是装进桶里的海。

normal.en: brine is Old English, not Latin.
normal.cn: brine 是古英语词，非拉丁来源。

normal.en: briny is the everyday adjective form.
normal.cn: briny 是日常形容词形式。

normal.en: brine shrimp thrive in salt lakes.
cooks brine meat to keep it juicy.
normal.cn: 厨师 brine（盐水浸）肉以保多汁。

normal.en: poets call the sea the briny deep.
normal.cn: 诗人称大海为 the briny deep。

abstract.en: The ocean folded small enough to fit a crock.
abstract.cn: 大海被折得小到能装进一只陶缸。

abstract.en: Salt as a preservative: time stopped at the waterline.
abstract.cn: 盐即防腐剂：时间在水位线处停驻。

abstract.en: Tears are brine with a story attached.
abstract.cn: 泪水是带着故事的盐卤。

examples.en: The fishmonger kept the herring in brine until Friday.
examples.cn: 鱼贩把鲱鱼养在卤水里直到周五。

examples.en: Salt mines pump brine to the surface for evaporation.
examples.cn: 盐矿把卤水抽到地面蒸发制盐。

examples.en: The wreck's timbers had soaked in brine for two centuries.
examples.cn: 沉船的木料在盐水中泡了两个世纪。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「不饮」——这水咸得「不饮」也罢：太咸不能喝的，就是 brine。

root: 古英语 brine／bryne（海水；咸水），属日耳曼语系（古撒克逊语 brina、古弗里西亚语 brine 同源）；与「灼烧」类词根 *brīnan- 的关联为学界一说，尚存争议。

sensesIntro.en: From the pickling crock to the open sea, then to tears, salt wells, and the chemist's cooling pipes.
sensesIntro.cn: 义项从腌菜缸到开阔大海，再到泪水、盐井与化学家的冷却管。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a crock of dark salt water keeping time still
core.cn: 核心意象：一缸深色盐水，让时间在水中停驻

branches.en: the kitchen: brining pickles, turkeys, olives
branches.cn: 厨房：腌菜、泡火鸡、渍橄榄

branches.en: the sea: open water and the taste it leaves
branches.cn: 大海：开阔水域及其留下的咸味

branches.en: the works: salt wells and cooling pipes
the extremes: human tears and hypersaline pools
branches.cn: 两个极端：人的泪与超盐水池

branches.en: the works: salt wells and cooling pipes

intro.en: A single native morpheme; compounds and derivatives grow directly on it.
intro.cn: 单一本族语素；复合词与派生词直接生长其上。

latinIntro.en: No Latin cognates; Latin sal covers the same ground in saline.
latinIntro.cn: 没有拉丁同源词；拉丁语以 sal 覆盖同类语义，成 saline。

items.example: the root of briny and brined
items.exampleCN: briny 与 brined 的词根

items.example: saline, salary both descend from sal
items.exampleCN: saline 与 salary 皆出 sal
